name: Back Office Overview
description: The owner's home screen: sidebar with every back-office page, an open/closed switch, today's numbers, the next bookings and a to-do list.
usage: Use it as the /admin home and as the layout for the other back-office screens (move the sidebar into your admin layout). Replace the sample numbers, bookings and to-dos with queries for today. Security: put every back-office screen behind sign-in (for example Supabase Auth or Clerk), let only the owner's account read or write this data (in Supabase, with row-level security on every table), and keep admin pages out of the public navigation and sitemap.
